title: Musicians in the ferry-boat photo: Alvin Clemons, Bokeye, John Smith
summary: Valentine names the drummer Alvin Clemons (Bokeye, a saxophonist), John Smith and the bassist Bouchon in the small ferry photograph.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who all was in the band? I can't hardly see anybody there.
Well, you see I had a boy called Alvin. He was playing drums. Alvin Clemons, he did, you know him. Alvin Clemons, what he called, Bokeye, Wilford Bokeye.
Is he a sax player or what? Yeah, saxophone player.
He's the fellow that was over there once when I heard him a couple years ago. Yeah, Bokeye.
Bokeye. And, uh, and you got, how many you got there?
One, two, three, four, five. Six, eh? I want to see five for sure. Five there.
No, that, that, that, that was Bokeye. That, that was, uh, John Smith. Oh.
Yeah. Who is the bass player on one end holding his bass?
That's the, Bouchon. The same fellow, don't you? Yeah, yeah, same fellow, huh?
